g.title: legend
g.text: Boxes: ROS nodes / named components. Notes: topics or launch constraints.
All cross-host ROS participants require matching domain / DDS network settings.
ONNX bench and hybrid hardware paths are alternatives, not one default launch.
Dashed red enclosure: deprecated application SDK paths (not the active MIT codec).
FK / collision checks and new speed / torque / tracking-error thresholds are NOT implemented.
